name: Software watchlist
instruction: Check the team's watched software for new releases and raise an upgrade ticket for each one that is behind.

plan.name: Read every source
plan.description: The Version checker reads the newest release of each watched software.

plan.name: Approval gate
plan.description: An Approver reviews all of the check's tickets in Teams with one decision.

plan.name: Create Jira tickets
plan.description: One upgrade ticket for each software that is behind.
